app.name: Owly
app.tagline: When they can't say where it hurts

onboarding.title: When they can't say it hurts, behavior is the language.
onboarding.body: Owly helps you record what you see — using the FLACC scale, the same tool nurses use for children who can't self-report pain — and turns weeks of observations into a clear, one-page report for the doctor.
onboarding.notdiagnosis: Owly is an observation journal. It does not diagnose. It helps you show a professional what you saw.
points: Validated pain scale (FLACC), individualized to your child
Everything stays on this device — nothing is sent anywhere

child.name: Name (or nickname)
child.communicatesHint: e.g. bangs head, pulls at ear, becomes very still, laughs when hurting
child.title: Your child's profile

customDescriptors.title: How does {{name}} show pain?
customDescriptors.body: Nurses call this individualized FLACC (rFLACC). Optional: describe the behaviors that are specific to your child for each category — they will appear as hints during observations.
customDescriptors.hint: e.g. pulls left ear, grinds teeth, holds breath

redflags.title: Get help now
redflags.body: Owly is not for emergencies. If any of these are present, stop and call emergency services or go to the ER:
items: Trouble breathing, or lips turning blue
Unresponsive, floppy, or very hard to wake
Stiff neck with fever, or a rash that doesn't fade when pressed
Signs of severe injury or poisoning
A baby under 3 months with fever
You feel something is seriously wrong — trust yourself
redflags.footer: When in doubt, call. You will never regret a call you didn't need.

observe.baselineQ: Is this a painful episode or a calm/baseline moment?
observe.baselineHint: A few baseline observations teach you and the doctor what your child's "normal" looks like.
observe.where: Where does it seem to hurt? (optional)
observe.causeHint: e.g. ear infection, teething, stomach ache, unknown
observe.noteHint: Anything else a doctor should know — e.g. was rocking, refused food, slept 2h

history.title: History
history.empty: No observations yet. The first one takes about a minute.

patterns.title: Patterns
patterns.empty: Patterns appear after a few observations.
patterns.insightNight: Most episodes happen at night — worth mentioning to the doctor.
patterns.insightZone: "{{zone}}" is the most suspected area ({{n}} episodes).

report.title: Doctor report
report.body: A one-page summary built for a busy clinician: who your child is, what you observed, patterns, and what you tried.
report.questionsHint: One per line — they'll appear on the report.
report.defaultQuestions:
Could this pattern suggest a specific cause?
Should any test be done (ears, tummy, sleep)?
Is a different pain-relief plan needed?
report.subtitle: Generate a one-page PDF to bring to the appointment.
report.q0: e.g. Could this be an ear infection?
report.q1: e.g. Is the medication plan still right?
includes: How your child usually signals discomfort
Episode timeline with FLACC scores, areas and notes
Patterns: time of day, recurring areas, what helps
report.localNote: Generated entirely on this device — nothing is uploaded.
report.empty: Record at least one pain episode first — the report needs observations.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataBody: Everything is stored only in this browser, on this device. No account, no cloud, no tracking.
settings.deleteConfirm: This permanently deletes every profile and observation on this device. Type DELETE to confirm.
settings.pinBody: Require a 4-digit PIN to open Owly. Protects the journal when others use this device.
settings.pinSaved: PIN saved — Owly will ask for it on next open
settings.importError: Couldn't read that file — is it an Owly backup?
settings.demoBody: Load “Léo” — a fictional 9-year-old with 3 weeks of observations, to try every feature instantly.
settings.license: Owly is free and open source (MIT). FLACC: Merkel et al. 1997 — public clinical instrument. Owly is an observation journal, not a medical device.
